correctness.rationale: Every flip on the cubic Petersen graph strictly reduces disagreeing-edge count by one or three, establishing a finite DAG and almost-sure terminal absorption. Every nonconstant absorber consists of two complementary five-cycles; the 12 such masks and two consensuses are exhaustively checked. A full 1024-state Fraction recurrence and a separate KG(5,2) 18-orbit quotient independently yield B_3=88/9, B_4=8242/189, B_5=12788/189 and symmetric coefficients with all others zero, and verify the claimed polynomial identity at 11 rational points. The twelve frozen states are a single S5 orbit, proving equal outcome probabilities for iid data. All packages are finite exact calculations, not finite evidence for an infinite claim.

value.rationale: The result solves the exact physically motivated finite-size trapping-probability problem for the unique cubic girth-five cage and all initial Bernoulli densities, identifies 12 equiprobable nonconsensus outcomes, and gives a sharp unique maximizer p=1/2. It is a reproducible kinetic benchmark, distinct from and more informative than its previously known static metastable-state count. No larger-graph implication is asserted.
